policies.name: dep-quad1-c2 — walk + quad-trick lineage
policies.notes: Same contract lineage as vref1-r1 with a four-leg-stand trick trained in (front pair unloads on command — in sim only; the robot has no runner mode for the trick). Implication: on hardware this is just an alternative walk, never bench-tested — use as a curiosity A/B against tip1, not as the daily driver.

policies.name: dep-tip1 walk (lean-recovery DR)
policies.notes: dep-vref1-r1 + 2M steps of tipped-start DR: 30% of training episodes spawn already leaned 6-18 deg and the policy is paid to level out. Hardware 08-10/11: 3 clean walks, 1 runaway — better than the parent and it keeps all six legs cycling under lean instead of sacrificing one, but it is NOT immune to the roll ramp. Implication: the current best pick for driving at 0.05 m/s; walks in a low shuffle (commanded posture, known and cosmetic).

policies.name: dep-vref1-r1 — walk champion (hardware contract)
policies.notes: Walk champion of the deployment-contract line: trained on the exact robot interface — no real velocity feedback (meas:=ref), 25-deg tilt envelope, 0.05-0.06 m/s band. Hardware 08-10: walks, but twice built a runaway sideways lean ending in a tip (pinned-leg positive feedback). Implication: fine for short A/B runs, but expect a possible roll ramp — hit X the moment it leans past ~15 deg.

policies.name: stance_dr10 — stance champion
policies.notes: Pre-deployment-contract stance champion (rise/hold/lower at full DR in sim). Hardware 08-10: its stand-up does NOT transfer — legs do air geometry with no ground force, then a knee stalls (trained before the rate clamp + self-collision limits were in the sim). Implication: keep only as fallback for Lower/holds; never use its RL Stand up — the Experiments-tab tuck is the stand-up.

policies.name: footlow2-hard1 stand/sit (RISE+HOLD+LOWER 10M candidate)
policies.notes: SIM DEPLOYMENT CANDIDATE 08-12 (all 4 gate clauses + eval_session hard gates PASS; src zip md5 680e8e0e, pulled from train-0). NOT bench-tested, single seed (s1 twin queued). First policy clean on rise+hold+lower at once: cold flat rise 12/12 h_err<=3.4mm, six-foot hold duty 0.95-0.99, lower 12/12 flush; interactive rise reaches full 148mm by 9.5s where holdbc1_hard1 stalls at 55mm. The hardware belly-curl knife-edge (3-foot support window, 10/10 tilt_roll trips on holdbc1_hard1) is UNTESTED by this lineage - hand ready, 10deg trip + 2.5A trip armed, scripted stand glide is the fallback. holdbc1_hard1 stays ACTIVE unless the operator selects this file.

policies.name: holdbc1-hard1 stand/sit (HOLD+RISE 10M)
policies.notes: EXPERIMENTAL on hardware — watch it. Overnight 08-11 HOLD+RISE+LOWER specialist: quiet six-foot hold (feet factor 0.99-1.0), belly-to-plant rise tracks a recorded reference, trained lower/sit. Sim: hold 11/12 valid, crouch-start rise still tips 2/4 — NOT hardware-validated, no deployment-contract flags. Try SIT and HOLD first; for stand-up keep a hand ready and use Experiments tab tuck as the known-good fallback. Meta carries the TRAINED goal ramp (hold 5s, ramp 6s, +111mm): re-select/push this file before STAND — the 08-11-morning copy (md5 6620705c) lacks it and the runner falls back to the legacy +50mm/4s ramp, an out-of-distribution command for this policy.
